results.name: Military Outpost Kit 1.0 (CC0)
results.description:
CC0

As sketchfab does not allow you to untick the Attribution box when uploading this model is sorted as CC-BY.

You can also download this file on Blendswap and is free to use in any capacity.

Can be used as scenery or game props, you can coble together a small military outpost in a few hours or build varying detailed bunkers.

Updates coming in the future for more stuff, and detail.

results.name: Pro Ex-120-СПП-ПВ-О
results.description: Explosion-proof ProEx spotlight features increased brightness and reduced power consumption compared to other light sources, which makes this series of explosion-proof luminaires absolutely unique and indispensable for economical lighting of any industrial and commercial areas. Explosion-proof LED spotlight ProEx has the type of explosion protection d - explosion-proof enclosure, explosion protection marking 1Ex d IIC and is designed to illuminate explosive zones of classes 1 and 2 indoors and outdoors, including lighting of commodity parks of oil and gas and petrochemical industries, where an increased lamp height. The ProEx explosion-proof searchlight has several mounting options: on the bracket (C), the swivel bracket (PS) and on the swivel floodlight bracket (SPP). The kit offers various types of explosion-proof cable glands and plugs.
